description: Na₃CuO₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.86 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Cu is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.82 Å) and two longer (1.88 Å) Cu-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Cu atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Cu₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 33°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Cu atom.
